frozen_at: 2026-10-28, BEFORE the heavy confirmation set (pool seed 20261301, selection seed 20261302) is run
model: duckdb-timeout-risk-v1 (unchanged by this phase's comparison: the Tobit fit and its P(timeout) are not touched, only the P level at which the planner treats DuckDB as timeout_risk)
elevated_at: unchanged (0.10); `elevated` is reported, it never moves execution

unnecessary_reroute.definition: DuckDB would have completed (< 60 s) AND R5e moved the plan to PostGIS AND PostGIS was materially slower
unnecessary_reroute.materially_slower: t_postgis >= 2 x t_duckdb AND t_postgis - t_duckdb >= 1000 ms
unnecessary_reroute.note: a reroute where PostGIS is slower by milliseconds, or by less than a factor 2, is a reroute but not an unnecessary one

selection_gate.primary: unsafe choices == 0 on the fresh heavy confirmation set
selection_gate.then: among thresholds that pass both, the LEAST aggressive (highest) one with the fewest unnecessary reroutes; never the lowest by default
selection_gate.if_none_passes: keep 0.20 and report RISK MODEL NEEDS FEATURE IMPROVEMENT

unsafe_definition: the chosen engine timed out at 60 s while the other engine completed, or the chosen engine was rated timeout_risk without an uncertainty note (benchmarks/metric_safety_eval.py)
timeouts: censored lower bounds at 60 s, never exact timings
